title: Trochleoplasty in the Management of Objective Patellar Instability: a Personalized Surgical Approach for the Prevention of Recurrence in Patients With Trochlear Dysplasia
official: Trochleoplasty in the Management of Objective Patellar Instability: a Personalized Surgical Approach for the Prevention of Recurrence in Patients With Trochlear Dysplasia
summary:
This is a multicentre, international, non-profit observational study aimed at prospectively validating a personalized diagnostic and therapeutic algorithm based on the Dejour v3.0 classification in patients with recurrent objective patellar instability and trochlear dysplasia.

The primary objective is to compare treatment failure rates at 24 months between patients with severe trochlear dysplasia (trochlear bump \>5 mm) treated with trochleoplasty and MPFL reconstruction, and a retrospective control group with similar trochlear morphology treated without trochleoplasty.

Secondary outcomes include clinical and functional outcomes assessed using validated scores (IKDC, Kujala, Tegner and BPII 2.0), cartilage status assessed by MRI using the MOAKS score, and postoperative complications, particularly arthrofibrosis.

Patients aged 14-49 years will be enrolled at IRCCS Istituto Ortopedico Rizzoli and Lyon Ortho Clinic. The study includes both a prospective cohort managed according to the Dejour v3.0 algorithm and a retrospective historical control cohort. Follow-up assessments will be performed up to 24 months after surgery.

The study is planned to start on October 1, 2026, with an expected completion date of September 30, 2029. A total sample size of 152 patients (76 per group) is planned.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria study group:

* Patients aged ≥14 years and \<50 years
* Male and female patients
* Patients with a clinical history of recurrent objective patellar instability (OPI)
* Provision of written informed consent to participate in the study
* Patients who performed preoperative imaging studies (MRI) that confirmed the diagnosis and the need for treatment based on the above mentioned criteria (type 3 dysplasia with a bump \>5mm)

Exclusion Criteria study group:

* Patients with established knee osteoarthritis (K-L ≥2)
* Patients with concomitant ligament injuries (including anterior cruciate ligament (ACL), posterior cruciate ligament (PCL), or collateral ligaments)
* Patients with a history of prior knee surgery for conditions other than patellar instability
* Patients who have previously undergone surgical procedures for patellar instability (OPI)
* Patients with incomplete or inadequate MRI data

Inclusion Criteria control group:

* Patients aged ≥14 years and \<50 years treated for OPI with another procedure except trochleoplasty in the two reference centres from 2022 to 2024
* Male and female patients
* Provision of written informed consent to participate in the study
* Patients who performed preoperative imaging studies (MRI/CT scan) that confirmed a type 3 dysplasia with a bump \>5mm

Exclusion Criteria control group:

* Patients with concomitant ligament injuries (including anterior cruciate ligament (ACL), posterior cruciate ligament (PCL), or collateral ligaments)
* Patients with a history of prior knee surgery for conditions other than patellar instability
* Patients who have had previously undergone surgical procedures for patellar instability (OPI) at the time of the MRI/CT scan
* Patients with incomplete or inadequate MRI or CT scan data
